evidence: Homepage shows all 8 job listings by default under "Showing 8 jobs"
Industry filter (Technology→2 jobs), Location filter (New York, NY→1 job), Job Type filter (Contract→1 job) all correctly narrowed results
Searching "Python" correctly returned the Data Analyst job which has Python as a skill
All filter/search changes updated the result list and count immediately without page reload
Each job card displays title, company, location, salary range, date, industry/type tags, and skills
Filled valid Full Name, Email, Cover Letter and submitted; got "Application submitted!" toast confirmation
Job details page shows title, company, location, salary, posted date, full description with Responsibilities/Requirements, and Required Skills section
Empty form submission blocked via required-field validation; invalid email "not-an-email" blocked with "Please include an '@' in the email address" message
Valid application submission returned success toast "Application submitted!" with no errors

actual: Submitted a second application for job-1 using the exact same name/email (test.user@example.com) as a prior successful application; the system accepted it again and displayed "Application submitted!" with no duplicate warning or rejection.

evidence: Filled Job Title, Industry, Employment Type, Location, Salary range, Description, and a skill; clicked Post Job; got "Job posted successfully!" toast and new listing "QA Automation Engineer" appeared in employer dashboard

issue: No edit functionality for job listings
actual: Each job row on the employer dashboard only has an applications-count toggle and a single icon button that opens a "Delete this job?" confirmation dialog. Deleting works correctly (job removed, Active Jobs count decremented), but no edit/pencil button or edit page exists anywhere to modify an already-published job listing.

evidence: Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all posted jobs with title, industry, type, location, salary, and post date
Clicking the application-count button on any job (e.g. "4" for Senior Frontend Developer) expands a list of submitted applications with applicant name, contact info, message, and date
Submitting the Post Job form empty was blocked by required-field validation with clear messages e.g. "Please fill out this field." on Job Title, Salary fields, and Description
Applications list for Senior Frontend Developer clearly shows 4 distinct entries with individual names (Test User x2, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia), separate emails/phones, messages and dates

issue: No role-based access control preventing job seekers from posting jobs
actual: There is no login/authentication or role system in the app at all (no "Log in"/"Sign in" links, no role selection). The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job page are visible and freely accessible in the main navigation to any visitor without any restriction, so a job seeker can post job openings just like an employer.
